name: StoreAgent – WooCommerce AI Chat, Content & Insights
author: Josh Kohlbach

sections.description:
🟡 **StoreAgent – WooCommerce AI tools for your store **

StoreAgent is your WooCommerce AI tool kit, powered by the StoreAgent AI platform. It’s all your AI content tools, AI insights and AI chat rolled into one.

Our smart AI chat widget answers shopper questions in real time, our AI content tools help you write product pages that
convert, and our AI insights keep improving your store every day. No separate apps, no code – just install and go.

🧠 Why Use StoreAgent?

✅ Slash Your First-Response Support Times

Use StoreAgent Chat our AI chat bot solution to slash first-response support times and reduce repetitive support
questions by 70% or more. Free your team from answering the same questions over and over with a conversational AI chat bot
that’s trained on your product data.

✅ Ship SEO-Ready Product Pages In Seconds

AI Product Description Generation tool are included in StoreAgent Content for all accounts, even free plans. To create
amazing product descriptions simply answer a couple of questions about your product and watch as our e-commerce trained AI
creates your product descriptions in a flash.

✅ Insights Delivered To Your Dashboard

Ever wonder if AI can analyze your products and suggest improvements? StoreAgent will actively help you understand content
improvement opportunities to help you boost your conversions over time. In many cases, it’s one‑click to use the AI tools
and implement the changes. It’s the ultimate balance between having control over what’s happening but leveraging AI to
do the hard work.

✅ No More Copy+Paste Or Fiddling With API Keys

Most AI tools feel like you’re baby sitting a chat prompt – StoreAgent is different. If you’re still copy and pasting from
a ChatGPT window you’re missing out on e-commerce AI agent tools that are specifically trained and tuned for store owners needs.

There’s also no digging for API keys in platform provider dashbaords. There’s no API keys needed with StoreAgent, just
connect your store and get started.

💬 StoreAgent Chat (Pro plans and up)

Deliver instant AI answers, from your product data. StoreAgent Chat is conversational, using your own product data to
talk to your customers naturally, giving them instant answers.

✅ Slash first‑response times to under 10 seconds
✅ Reduce repetitive questions by up to 70 percent
✅ Boost conversions with deep product knowledge
✅ Serve unlimited shoppers at once, 24/7
✅ Customise the widget to match your brand, colours, and tone
✅ Trained on your own product data, right down to the meta.

🚀 Unlock All Features

Start with a free Lite plan, which includes all the StoreAgent Content features to generate product content then, when
you’re ready, unlock Pro features with higher AI task limits and full conversational WooCommerce AI chat.

🟢 AI Chat Widget (Pro) – Real‑time, conversational support that understands your entire catalogue – powered by your product data
🟢 Product‑Aware Conversations (Pro) – Answers pulled directly from titles, specs, attributes, and reviews
🟢 Full Chat History Logs (Pro) – Review every conversation and uncover new content ideas
🟢 Custom Quick‑Replies (Pro) – Set the preferred tone of AI chat responses
🟢 WooCommerce Integration – Works out of the box with WooCommerce and WooCommerce compatible themes
🟢 Multi‑language Detection – Answers shoppers in their own language

Content & SEO Tools

✍️ Product Descriptions – SEO‑friendly copy in seconds
⚡ Short Descriptions – Scroll‑stopping blurbs auto‑generated from the long copy
🏷️ Product Tags – One‑click tag suggestions for better search rankings
❓ Product Q&A – Captures common questions and publishes the AI answer as rich content
⭐ Review Summaries – Turns mountains of reviews into punchy social proof

AI Insights

🔔 Automated Notifications – StoreAgent surfaces quick fixes to the StoreAgent Dashboard so you can improve your product listings easily
📈 Content Quality – Monitors content length and quality with one click buttons to improve

🌍 Built for WordPress & WooCommerce

  • Install and connect your store in just a few minutes
  • Compatible with any WooCommerce‑ready theme
  • Lightweight, CDN‑served assets and GDPR‑compliant

🆓 Get Started for Free

Keep the free plan as long as you like, with generous free plan inclusions. Upgrade when you are ready for AI chat, more advanced features, and higher AI limits.

See all plans at storeagent.ai/pricing/.

Feedback and Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature suggestions, please reach out to us at support@storeagent.ai.

Have an idea for an AI tool? Let us know.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file (if installing manually).
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to StoreAgent > Settings to configure your AI agents and connect your StoreAgent.ai account.
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreAgent.ai account to use this plugin?

Yes, an active StoreAgent.ai account is required. Sign up here.

Is this a free WooCommerce AI plugin?

Yes, StoreAgent.ai offers a free plan with generous inclusions. Get started with AI on your WooCommerce store for free. Want to unlock everything including AI Chat? Grab a Pro plan.

Can I customize the AI tools?

Absolutely! You can fine-tune behavior and settings via the plugin dashboard.

Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, StoreAgent.ai is compatible with all WooCommerce-compliant themes including block themes.

How does this differ from other AI tools?

Most AI tools feel like you’re babysitting a chat interface. StoreAgent is different — it’s built specifically for e-commerce tasks. No fiddling with prompts, no more copying & pasting between tools. Just smart, purpose-built features that live right inside your dashboard and actually helps you get stuff done for your store — fast.
